questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code maps failures to HTTP status codes and error responses? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A bulk request of 50 documents is processed and 7 of them fail (for example mapping errors) while 43 succeed. What does the client receive?
A caller requests from=9990 and size=50 on an existing index. What happens?
choices: The page is served, truncated to the last 10 results of the window
The service is called and any limit is enforced by the backend
The request is rejected with 400 window_too_large before the service is called
A 200 is returned with an empty hits list

questions.prompt: While a node restarts, search throws IndexRecoveringException. What does the response tell the client?
choices: 404 index_not_found, since the index cannot be read
